div.p: Linux Log Monitoring • Splunk Enterprise • MITRE ATT&CK

search.query: index=main sourcetype=save | stats count as value
index=main sourcetype=save "Failed password" | stats count as value
index=main sourcetype=save ("Accepted password" OR "session opened") | stats count as value
index=main sourcetype=save | stats dc(host) as value

index=main sourcetype=save | head 10 | rex "for invalid user (?<user>[\w.]+)" | rex "session opened for user (?<user>[\w.]+)" | rex "USER=(?<user>[\w.]+)" | rex "from (?<src_ip>[\d.]+)" | eval user=coalesce(user,"-"), src_ip=coalesce(src_ip,"-") | eval status=case(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed",match(_raw,"session opened"),"Success",match(_raw,"Accepted"),"Success",1=1,"Info") | table _time, _raw, user, src_ip, status | rename _time as "Time", _raw as "Event", src_ip as "Source IP"

index=main sourcetype=save | eval Event=case(match(_raw,"Failed password"),"Failed SSH Login",match(_raw,"Accepted password"),"Successful Login",match(_raw,"session opened"),"Successful Login",match(_raw,"COMMAND="),"Privilege Escalation",1=1,"Other") | eval Technique=case(Event=="Failed SSH Login","Brute Force",Event=="Successful Login","Valid Accounts",Event=="Privilege Escalation","Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism",1=1,"Unknown") | eval "Technique ID"=case(Event=="Failed SSH Login","T1110",Event=="Successful Login","T1078",Event=="Privilege Escalation","T1548",1=1,"-") | eval Status=case(Event=="Failed SSH Login","Detected",Event=="Successful Login","Monitored",Event=="Privilege Escalation","Detected",1=1,"Monitored") | stats count by Event, Technique, "Technique ID", Status | sort -count | table Event, Technique, "Technique ID", Status, count | rename count as "Occurrences"

index=main sourcetype=save | stats count as total, count(eval(match(_raw,"Failed password"))) as failed, count(eval(match(_raw,"COMMAND="))) as sudo | eval summary=case(total==0,"No security events detected in the monitored period.",failed>0,"Detected " . failed . " failed SSH login attempt(s). This activity maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1110 (Brute Force).",sudo>0,"Sudo privilege escalation observed. This activity maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1548 (Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism).",1=1,"Monitoring active. No suspicious activity detected.") | table summary
